say:3:1311128002:1.text: Sorry, did I scare you? I'm really sorry...
say:3:1311128002:1.source_cn: 嗯，抱歉，我是不是吓到客人了……请您原谅……

say:4:1311128003:1.text: I'm... an everbloom that grows in this manor. I can move and think, all thanks to His Lordship's magic.
say:4:1311128003:1.source_cn: 我是……是生长在这座庄园里的永寂花，子爵先生用魔法为我...

say:5:1311128004:1.text: Wow, that's some serious magic! So, what do you do around here?
say:5:1311128004:1.source_cn: 这是很高深的魔法！你平常在庄园里负责什么事情？

say:7:1311128005:1.text: I... take care of His Lordship's painting supplies and artworks.
say:7:1311128005:1.source_cn: 我……负责管理子爵先生的绘画材料和工具，还有……还有画...

say:8:1311128006:1.text: Sadly, many stunning pieces have fallen victim to the passage of time and have decayed...
say:8:1311128006:1.source_cn: 可惜，有许多漂亮的画都无法对抗时间的侵蚀，已经腐朽了……

say:9:1311128007:1.text: I don't understand why His Lordship won't enchant them and instead lets these exquisite pieces fade away...
say:9:1311128007:1.source_cn: 我不明白，子爵先生为什么不肯为它们附魔，而是任由这些精...

say:10:1311128008:1.text: Ah, I must be so foolish... I can never seem to understand His Lordship's thoughts...
say:10:1311128008:1.source_cn: 啊，我太笨了，总是无法理解子爵先生的想法……
